title: GeoRail
description: GeoRail is a vast, friendly and fun server for everyone. Offering a very high playing and building quality!
body:
![GeoRail banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b907caaddbf85765e223f084ad1fee384c87911.png)

# Welcome to GeoRail!

## What is Geo?

GeoRail is a **inviting and friendly** community, with a helpful staff team and kind members! The server features many standard amenities like rules **perfectly tailored** for the server, democracy and the **highest quality** builds in the entire catalogue of MTR servers! 

## Why Geo?

**Place for you**
> We made GeoRail a place for everybody! We accept everyone and we are happy to do so since 2024! We are keen on exploring new builds by many of our builders from multiple countries and continents!

**Many popular members**
> There are many famous people from around the MTR community on our server, like SzandorThe13th, Vitor2005_ and many many more! We also feature fun bots for entertainment when the server is down for maintenance! 

**Quality over quantity**
> We value all aspects of quality on our server. We polish every build up to perfection, while keeping the Minecraft-y feel to it! There are numerous cities which will * really soon* be interconnected using the **GeoStar :train2: **, which is a high speed operator exclusive to GeoRail!
